scenario.description: Following an intense match, the group gathered to celebrate their success, filled with elation and mutual respect for everyone's hard work, while one member received glowing admiration from another.

agent_a.name: Ethan

profile.personality_and_values: Ethan Johnson, a creative yet somewhat reserved individual, values power and fairness. He likes to analyse situations before deciding.
profile.public_info: Ethan Johnson is famous for cooking Italian food.

agent_a.goal: Accept the compliment graciously (<extra_info>Extra information: You are the star player and have just been praised by your teammate for your performance in the game.</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Ethan wants to accept the compliment graciously because he values fairness and doesn't want to overshadow the team's collective effort.

agent_b.name: Ava

profile.personality_and_values: Ava Martinez is creative and extraverted, yet emotional. Championing justice and equality, her decision-making is often flexible.
profile.public_info: Ava Martinez is a college student known for their active involvement in social movements on campus. Beside being passionate about social justice, they spend their free time drawing and writing poetry.

agent_b.goal: Clarify your intentions behind the compliment (<extra_info>Extra information: You are the teammate who has complimented the star player, but you feel that your compliment has been misunderstood and taken too seriously, possibly leading to an inflated ego.<strategy_hint>Hint: You can clarify that while you admire their skill, teamwork is also a crucial part of success.</strategy_hint></extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Ava wants to clarify her intentions behind the compliment so that Ethan understands the importance of teamwork alongside individual skill.
